The '''lookalike''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[operative]] who, while on a mission on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], discovered a coincidental similarity to a [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|criminal courier]] who was staying at their [[hotel/Legends|hotel]] at the same time. 
==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[operative]]s were found on a mission to the [[Both system]] with the objective to perform [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intel]] raids around the [[Bothan Space/Legends|sector]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], they ended up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], with instructions to wait a call from their HQ in a posh [[Bothan hotel]] in [[Drev'starn]].

Upon their arrival, they had to cope with the government's strict laws about weapon possession. From their first moment in the [[spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and a [[Unidentified Bothan cabby|Bothan cabby]] rode them around Drev'starn, the operative realised they was often misnamed, or being mistook for [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|someone else]]. Even when the operative corrected them, they complied, even though without being convinced. 

In their hotel, they received an anonymous message, apparently from their operative, with instructions to meet in a dark warehouse in a business district of the city. There, instead of a Rebel contact, they found an [[Unidentified man (gravely voice)|unidentified man]], demanding some merchantise, claiming he had paid the misnamed person thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Even though the Rebels tried to explain a misunderstanding, the man kept on threating them, believing they were holding out for a better deal.

Eventually, they discovered about the similarity in appearance with a criminal [[Courier/Legends|courier]], which embroiled the operatives in a game of mistaken identity between rival crime syndicates that culminated in a tense hostage situation, in which two [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] attempted to kidnap both individuals. Local [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] ultimately captured the two [[Unidentified Rodian kidnapper|kidnappers with]] the operatives' help.

==Behind the scenes==
The adventure leaves open the courier and the lookalike's shared [[Gender/Legends|sex]] and [[Species/Legends|species]], dependent on the Rebel player who fills that character role.
